tools.name: get_dialing_instructions
tools.description: Exact digits to dial a phone in another country from the caller's country: exit code, country code, and the national number with its trunk prefix correctly dropped or kept, plus the + form for mobiles and numbered steps. Use it for any "how do I call this country or number" question, including share

tools.name: get_call_price
tools.description: Per-minute price of calling a country, or a specific number, from a web browser with InternationalCall.co: the live rate, how billing works (prepaid credit, no subscription), and a link that opens the dialer set to that country. Use it when someone asks what a call abroad costs or how to call a phon

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_call_price" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
